verses.text: <pb/><t>N'elu ihe-ndinam n'abali ka m'chọrọ onye ahu nke nkpuru-obim huru n'anya:</t> <t>Achọrọm ya, ma achọtaghm ya.</t>
<t>M'siri, Biko, ka m'bilie, jegharia n'obodo buruburu,</t> <t>N'amá nile na n'ebe nile sara mbara,</t> <t>Ka m'chọ onye ahu nke nkpuru-obim huru n'anya:</t> <t>Achọrọm ya, ma achọtaghm ya.</t>
<t>Ndi-nche ndi nējeghari n'obodo buruburu hurum:</t> <t>M'we si ha, Ùnu ahuwo onye ahu nke nkpuru-obim huru n'anya?</t>

<t>Ọ bu nání nwantī ka m'siri n'ebe ha nọ gabiga,</t> <t>Mb͕e m'chọtara onye ahu nke nkpuru-obim huru n'anya:</t> <t>Ejiderem ya, arakwaghm ya aka,</t> <t>Rue mb͕e m'mere ka ọ ba n'ulo nnem,</t> <t>Na n'ime-ulo nke nwayi turu imem. <pb/></t>

<t>Unu umu-ndinyom Jerusalem,</t> <t>Ejim nne-mb͕ada nile, ejikwam nne-ele ọhia nile, b͕a unu iyi,</t> <t>Unu akpọtela, unu eme-kwa-la ka ihu-n'anya teta, ma-ọli,</t> <t>Rue mb͕e ọ gātọ ya utọ. <pb/></t>

<t>Ọnye bu nka nke nēsi n'ọzara arigota dika ogidi di iche iche nke anwuru-ọku,</t> <t>Nke anēsurere ya ihe-nsure-ọku nēsì ísì utọ, bú myrrh na frankincense,</t> <t>Site n'ihe nile egwere egwe nke onye-ahia?</t>
<t>Le, ọ bu ihe-ndina-ya, bú nke Solomon nwere;</t> <t>Ọgu ndi-dike atọ di ya buruburu,</t> <t>Site na ndi-dike nke Israel.</t>
<t>Ha nile ji mma-agha, ha bu ndi emeworo ka ha muta ibu agha:</t> <t>Onye ọ bula, mma-agha-ya di n'úkwù-ya,</t> <t>N'ihi egwu n'abali.</t>
<t>Eze, bú Solomon, emeworo onwe-ya otù palanquin</t> <t>Site n'osisi Lebanon.</t>

<t>Ogidi-ya nile ka o jiri ọla-ọcha me,</t> <t>Ala-ya ka o jiri ọla-edo me, ebe-ọnọdu-ya ka o jiri ogho ododo me,</t> <t>Etiti-ya, eji ihu-n'anya me ka ọ buru pavement ọma,</t> <t>Site n'aka umu-ndinyom Jerusalem.</t>
<t>Puanu, umu-ndinyom Zaion, lekwasi Solomon, bú eze, anya,</t> <t>Ka o kpuru okpu-eze nke nne-ya kpubeworo ya n'ubọchi ọlulu-nwunye-ya,</t> <t>Na n'ubọchi ọṅù nke obi-ya.</t>
